settings.ytSearchResults: Number of yt-dlp search results fetched per query. Lower values = faster matching, but higher risk of incorrect matches
settings.ytSearchTimeout: Timeout duration per search during matching (ms). Lower values = faster UI response, but more "not found" errors on slow networks
settings.ytSearchStagger: Delay applied when starting parallel searches (ms). Helps avoid system and rate limits by staggering concurrent requests — lower values = faster requests; higher values = smoother operation and usually fewer restrictions

settings.ytDefaultRegion: Default YouTube region / country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) (e.g. US)
settings.ytmAuthUser: Google account index used with YouTube Music browser cookies. Leave blank/0 for a single account; with multiple accounts enter 0, 1, 2... for the account used by YouTube Music. No API key is required.
settings.enrichSpforYy: Search Spotify for tags during YouTube downloads (1 = yes)
settings.mediaComment: What should be written in the comment tag?
settings.ffmpegBin: ffmpeg path (including .exe). Leave empty if using exe, AppImage, Docker, or `npm run download:binaries`
settings.trustProxy: Reverse-proxy trust used for client IP detection and rate limiting. Keep 0 for direct/LAN/Electron use; set a positive hop count only when Gharmonize is intentionally behind trusted reverse proxy(s).
settings.ffmpegChannel: FFmpeg update channel. stable follows the latest release branch and is recommended; master follows development snapshots. The selection is used on the next binary refresh or restart.
settings.workarounds: Includes workarounds to bypass access restrictions (403 Forbidden errors) (1 = yes)
settings.ytdlpCookies: Cookies path (including .txt). If empty, BASE_DIR/cookies/cookies.txt will be used
settings.ytdlpBrowser: Browser to extract cookies from (disable when using Docker)
settings.ytdlpUA: User-Agent yt-dlp will present to YouTube
settings.ytdlpSCookies: Always disables YTDLP_COOKIES and YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER (1 = yes)
